title: Culturing of human pluripotent stem cells in a mesoderm biased state
protocol: Prepare basal medium E8 under sterile conditions.
Make large batches of 50X E8 supplements and freeze as 10ml aliquots at -20°C.
Defrost 10ml aliquots of E8 supplements and add them to 490ml of DMEM/F12 without glutamine.
Filter the mixed medium using a CytoOne Bottle Top Filtration Unit with a 0.2µM filter.
Prepare PRIMO Plus medium under sterile conditions.
Resuspend the CHIR99021 powder in DMSO at 10mM.
Resuspend the IWP-2 powder in DMSO at 5mM.
Resuspend the cholesterol powder in 100% ethanol at 20mM.
Dissolve 400mg of BSA (1% in final volume) in 5ml of E8 media at 37°C.
Add approximately 0.5ml of LPA to achieve a concentration of 4.8 µM in the final 40ml volume and incubate for 5 minutes.
Add 40µl of 20mM cholesterol (resulting in 20µM in the final volume) and incubate for an additional 5 minutes.
Add approximately 34.5ml of E8 media to reach a total volume of 40ml.
Filter sterilize the mixture with a 0.22µM filter.
Freeze or aliquot into smaller portions and store at -20°C.
Dilute the 5X stock 1:5 with E8 media (use 10ml of stock with 40ml of E8).
Add CHIR99021 to achieve a concentration of 3µM in PRIMO Plus.
Add IWP-2 to achieve a concentration of 1µM in PRIMO Plus.
Remove vitronectin aliquot from -80°C freezer and allow to thaw at room temperature.
Dilute vitronectin at 1:100 in 1X PBS.
Coat the surface of a tissue culture flask with vitronectin (3ml per T25, 2ml per T12.5) and leave at room temperature for a minimum of 1 hour.
Aspirate vitronectin from flasks and replace with PRIMO PLUS; use 3ml per T25/ 1.5ml per T12.5.
Remove media from confluent flask of hPSCs and wash gently with 1X PBS.
Add 1ml ReleSR to the bottom of flask, rock the flask back and forth to ensure all cells have been coated, incubate for ~20 seconds at RT.
Tilt the flask sufficiently that ReleSR pools in one of the bottom corners of the flask.
Aspirate away the ReleSR.
Incubate cells for 2-4 minutes at room temperature.
Add 2 ml of PRIMO PLUS medium to inactivate ReleSR.
Rock the flask back and forth slowly to encourage cell detachment.
Tap the flask gently to detach cells, avoiding aggressive tapping that may cause differentiated cells to detach as well.
Check cells under the microscope to assess colony size.
Resuspend pellet in an appropriate volume of PRIMO Plus medium.
Distribute resuspended cells into prepared flasks according to the desired splitting ratio.
Place cells into a 37°C 5% CO₂ incubator for culture.
Replace medium daily due to LPAs short half-life.
Passage cells before reaching high confluency (over 90%).
Feed cells so that the medium shows visible color change the following day.
Increase culture volume incrementally, starting from 3-4ml and up to 10ml by the day before passage for T25 cultures.
